Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1051
Claimant:
Tammy Barrett
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2024-08-28
Claim opened after the insured's vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant reports a back
strain and says the impact was sudden and forceful.
2024-09-05
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-09-08
Police report and the statements of the scene witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact.
The witnesses did not see the collision itself, so there are no independent eyewitnesses to the sequence of events.
2024-09-26
Photographs taken at the scene show the damage to the vehicle, and the pattern of damage lines up with the impact
described by the claimant. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection notes.
2024-10-03
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of how the collision happened was the same as the one given at first
notice, with no changes in the sequence or the details.
2024-11-25
The claimant's injury report fits the type and force of the crash. Medical records show the claimant was treated for a
complaint in the same area of the back within the last two years, and that prior condition is adding to the current
symptoms.
2024-12-02
Treatment followed a typical course, with early visits for pain and stiffness and then a gradual reduction in
appointments as the claimant improved. The provider's notes describe steady recovery.
2025-01-12
Second call with the claimant confirmed the same account of the collision, again without any variation. The claimant is
not represented by an attorney and has been handling communications directly.
2025-03-28
File reviewed and summarized for the supervisor. Vehicle damage, injury type, and treatment pattern are consistent
with the reported loss, with the prior back condition noted as a factor in the current complaints.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
